description: Parallel ST-style shards on two nodes (edit commands as needed). Do NOT run MT10 on node0 and MT20 on node1 at the same time if you need sequential MT10→MT20 on one lineage.

nodes.command: source .venv/bin/activate && python -m experiments.kernelbench.main --levels level1 --problems "$(cat config/shards/twenty_shard_0.csv)" --max-metric-calls 30 --max-refinements 1 --frontier-type instance --parallel --gpus 8 --run-name h100_st_shard0

source .venv/bin/activate && python -m experiments.kernelbench.main --levels level1 --problems "$(cat config/shards/twenty_shard_1.csv)" --max-metric-calls 30 --max-refinements 1 --frontier-type instance --parallel --gpus 8 --run-name h100_st_shard1
